subject.title: fix(plugins): find installed external web-search providers on fresh installs

question: Should this protected PR require redacted, inspectable real-runtime proof for both the fresh external-provider path and the first-message template behavior before it is considered for merge?
rationale: The submitted regression test supports the intended branch logic, but the claimed live benchmark results are not available as an artifact or transcript that reviewers can inspect.

options.title: Request focused runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or linked artifact showing an installed external provider with its API key resolves on a fresh workspace, plus a first-message task transcript from a newly seeded workspace.

options.title: Accept maintainer-run verification
options.body: A maintainer can independently reproduce both paths on the current merge result and record the outcome in the PR before merging.

recommendation.title: Request focused runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or linked artifact showing an installed external provider with its API key resolves on a fresh workspace, plus a first-message task transcript from a newly seeded workspace.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the implementation, test, and benchmark claims and are best positioned to attach the requested redacted runtime evidence.
